spec.caption:
Smart Contract Developer annual base estimates: USD 97,000 at 1 year; USD 124,000 at 7 years.

Both: North America, Series A/B, 11-50 staff. Tokens and equity excluded.

1. Security Auditor annual base estimates: USD 127,000 at 1 year; USD 163,000 at 7 years.

Difference: USD 36,000/year. Both use North America, Series A/B and 11-50 employees.

2. Product Manager annual base estimates: USD 91,000 at 1 year; USD 116,000 at 7 years.

Difference: USD 25,000/year, changing only experience. Region, company stage and size stay fixed.

3. Technical Writer annual base estimates: USD 72,000 at 1 year; USD 93,000 at 7 years.

Rounded from USD 72,450 and USD 93,150. Displayed gap: USD 21,000/year.

4. Community Manager annual base estimates: USD 60,000 at 1 year; USD 78,000 at 7 years.

The two experience scenarios differ by USD 18,000/year.

5. The 1-to-7-year salary estimate gap is USD 36,000/year for Security Auditor and USD 18,000 for Community Manager.

Set your experience, region, company stage and size to compare estimates.
